name: Auto Pins (India) Limited
about: Auto Pins (India) Limited designs, develops, manufactures, trades in, and sells leaf and parabolic springs, and automotive components under the SIROCCO brand in India and internationally. It offers U bolts, iron and steel products, spring pins, and trailer parts/suspension kits for use in trucks, tractors, and transport automobiles. The company was founded in 1953 and is based in Faridabad, India. Auto Pins (India) Limited is a subsidiary of Mystic Woodart Pvt Ltd.
